meta.title: Update C backend to use stack arrays
meta.body_summary: Optimize C code generation by using stack arrays for list expressions when possible, emitting contains_array_int instead of contains_list_int, and using listLenExpr/listItemExpr for query loops.

perf_labels.notes: Single-commit self-merge by maintainer with only narrative performance claim and no review or benchmark evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 279 changed lines, this is a small-to-medium edit by absolute volume. Most changes are test output updates, with a 49-line core compiler change. As a focused compiler optimization, the quick self-merge aligns with the low-risk, test-backed nature of the change.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal review, comments, or inline feedback in dataset.
review_details.performance_claim: Switching to stack arrays for list expressions when possible improves performance by avoiding heap allocations and using direct stack-based access.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Codex successfully implemented a stack-array codegen optimization in a compiler backend; the change was self-contained, test-updated, and merged without human review, indicating trust in the agent's code-generation capability.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR provides a go test command to verify correctness but no before/after performance benchmarks or profiling data.

core_change_summary.description: In compiler/x/c/compiler.go, added helper for contains_array_int and emit it when list expression is backed by a stack array. In compiler/x/c/runtime.go, added necessary runtime helpers. Regenerated all C machine test outputs to reflect the new code generation.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: All test output files in tests/machine/x/c/ were updated or removed (in_operator.error, membership.error) to match the new code generation.
